name: Dunaszentbenedek (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of blue and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Dunaszentbenedek (a blue and white shield with a black bird, with a helm, a white bird crest and blue and yellow mantling) above a scroll.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Dunaszentbenedek arms with helm, crest, mantling and scroll
